'''Candeiar''' is a [[Whitecloak]] who is expert in wounds that tends [[Galad]] after [[Asunawa]] is killed.
== Trivia ==
* Candeiar is named for Carlos Candeias, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
